verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a Console API described as 'the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.' That covers agent-driven management of Feature Gates, which the docs say toggle product behavior in real time. Statsig also ships an official MCP server for Codex, Cursor, Claude Code and ChatGPT. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of gate creation, targeting-rule editing and toggling as specific API or MCP operations; confirmation of which write actions the MCP server exposes; a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404); independent or hands-on corroboration of agents managing flags.
